questionStore.currentQuestion.beginGuideToSolve = true\n\n      // 第3步：清除聊天记录\n      const questionBmNo = questionStore.currentQuestion.bmNo\n      await aiExerciseStore.clearChatHistory(questionBmNo)\n      // 第4步：发送题目内容给AI进行分析（每次都是新的开始）\n      const questionContent =\n        questionStore.currentQuestion.question ||\n        questionStore.currentQuestion.title ||\n        '题目内容为空'\n      const initialMessage = &#96;我们开始吧，${questionContent}&#96;\n\n      await aiExerciseStore.sendMessage(\n        initialMessage,\n        questionStore.currentQuestion,\n        { id: '', userId: '' },\n        aiSubject,\n        'mate',\n        undefined,\n        true, // hidePrefix: true，存储到本地时去除\"我们开始吧\"前缀\n      )\n    }\n\n  } questionStore.currentQuestion.beginGuideToSolve = false\n    }\n\n    // 记录详细错误信息\n    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n    console.error('[QuestionList] })\n\n    // 根据错误类型显示更具体的错误提示\n    let userMessage = '启动AI指导失败'\n    if (\n      errorMessage.includes('网络') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('Network') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('fetch')\n    ) errorMessage.includes('权限') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('auth') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('401') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('403')\n    ) {\n      userMessage = '启动AI指导失败：权限不足，请重新登录'\n    } else if (\n      errorMessage.includes('服务器') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('server') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('500')\n    ) {\n      userMessage = '启动AI指导失败：服务器异常，请稍后重试'\n    } else if (errorMessage) {\n      userMessage = &#96;启动AI指导失败：${errorMessage}&#96;\n    }\n\n    showMessage(userMessage, 'error')\n  }\n}\n\n// 打开微课（使用Web技术实现）\nconst openMiniClass = async (question: ExerciseItem) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 使用硬编码的微课URL\n    const classUrl = 'https://www.imates.com.cn:9099/demo/demo1.html'\n\n    if (!classUrl || classUrl.trim() === '') {\n 清理题目高度缓存和观察器\nconst cleanupQuestionHeight = (questionId: string) =&gt; {\n  // 清理高度缓存\n  questionHeights.value.delete(questionId)\n\n  // 清理观察器\n  const observer = resizeObservers.get(questionId)\n qSubject.includes(targetSubject) ||\n            targetSubject.includes(qSubject)\n          )\n        })\n\n      // 如果当前没有目标科目的题目，需要重新加载\n      if (!hasTargetSubjectQuestions) {\n })\n  intersectionObservers.clear()\n\n  // 清理所有 ResizeObserver\n  resizeObservers.forEach((observer) =&gt; {\n    observer.disconnect()\n  })\n  resizeObservers.clear()\n\n  // 清理所有定时器\n = (nodes: TreeNode[], targetSessionId: string): TreeNode | null =&gt; {\n  for (const node of nodes) {\n    if (node.sessionId === targetSessionId) {\n      return node\n    }\n    if (node.children) {\n      const found = findNodeBySessionId(node.children, targetSessionId)\n      if (found) return found\n    }\n  }\n  return null\n}\n\n// 根据 sessionId 获取会话类型（需要在 computed setter 之前定义）\nconst sessionId)\n  if (!node) return null\n\n  if (node.category === 'ai') {\n    return 'ai-general'\n  } else if (['CHINESE', 'MATH', 'ENGLISH', 'POLITICS', 'HISTORY', 'GEOGRAPHY', 'PHYSICS', 'CHEMISTRY', 'BIOLOGY'].includes(node.category)) {\n    return 'teacher'\n  }\n\n  return null\n}\n\n// 选中的会话ID（computed 属性，用于双向绑定）\nconst selectedSessionId = computed({\n  get: () =&gt; _selectedSessionId.value,\n  set: (newSessionId: string | undefined) =&gt; {\n    const oldSessionId = _selectedSessionId.value\n    if (newSessionId === oldSessionId) {\n      return\n    }\n    \n    _selectedSessionId.value = newSessionId\n    \n    // 在 setter 中直接处理分类切换通知，而不是通过 watch\n    if (newSessionId) {\n      const category = getSessionCategory(newSessionId, treeNodes.value)\n      if (category === 'teacher') {\n        emit('category-should-change', 'teacher')\n      } else if (category === 'ai-general') {\n        emit('category-should-change', 'ai-general')\n      }\n    } else {\n      // 如果选中状态被清空，切换到 AI 分类\n      // 只有当之前有选中状态时才 emit，避免重复\n      if (oldSessionId !== undefined) {\n        emit('category-should-change', 'ai-general')\n      }\n    }\n  },\n})\n\n// 选中的节点ID\nconst selectedNodeId = ref&lt;string | null&gt;(null)\n\n\n// 滚动容器引用\nconst scrollWrapper = ref&lt;HTMLElement | null&gt;(null)\n\n// 未读消息 store\nconst unreadStore = useUnreadMessageStore()\n\n// AI 和教师聊天 store\nconst aiGeneralStore = useAiGeneralChatStore()\nconst teacherChatStore = useTeacherChatStore()\n\n// 收藏状态更新触发器（用于触发 treeNodes 重新计算收藏状态）\n// 注意：收藏状态存储在 localStorage 中，不是响应式的，所以需要手动触发\nconst favoriteUpdateTrigger = ref(0)\n\n// 会话更多菜单显示状态（key 为 sessionId）\nconst showMoreMenu = ref&lt;Record&lt;string, boolean&gt;&gt;({})\n\n// 删除确认对话框\nconst deleteDialogRef = ref&lt;InstanceType&lt;typeof Dialog&gt;&gt;()\nconst pendingDeleteNode = ref&lt;TreeNode | null&gt;(null)\n\n// 删除处理中状态\nconst deleting = ref(false)\n\n// 删除确认内容\nconst deleteConfirmContent = computed(() =&gt; {\n  return &#96;确定要删除会话 \"${pendingDeleteNode.value?.label || ''}\" 吗？删除后无法恢复。&#96;\n})\n\n// ==================== 计算属性 ====================\n\n\n// 树节点类型定义\ninterface TreeNode {\n  id: string\n  label: string\n  category: 'ai' | 'teacher' | 'CHINESE' | 'MATH' | 'ENGLISH' | 'POLITICS' | 'HISTORY' | 'GEOGRAPHY' | 'PHYSICS' | 'CHEMISTRY' | 'BIOLOGY'\n  level: number\n  children?: TreeNode[]\n  sessionId?: string\n  timestamp?: number\n  subtitle?: string\n  pinned?: boolean\n  favorited?: boolean\n}\n\n// 构建树形节点\n// 使用 computed 从 store 的响应式数据中获取，自动同步更新\nconst treeNodes = computed&lt;TreeNode[]&gt;(() =&gt; {\n  // 依赖 favoriteUpdateTrigger 来触发收藏状态重新计算\n  void favoriteUpdateTrigger.value\n  \n  const nodes: TreeNode[] = []\n\n  // 1. AI聊天（学伴默认）分类\n  // aiGeneralStore.sessions 已经是响应式的 ref，computed 会自动追踪\n  const aiSessionsList = searchKeyword.value\n    ? aiGeneralStore.sessions.filter((session) =&gt; {\n        const name = session.sessionName?.toLowerCase() || ''\n        return name.includes(searchKeyword.value.toLowerCase().trim())\n      })\n    : aiGeneralStore.sessions\n  \n  const aiSessions = aiSessionsList\n    .sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n      // 置顶的排在前面\n      if (a.pinned &amp;&amp; !b.pinned) return -1\n      if (!a.pinned &amp;&amp; b.pinned) return 1\n      // 按更新时间倒序\n      return b.updateTime - a.updateTime\n    })\n    .map(\n      (session): TreeNode =&gt; ({\n        id: &#96;ai_${session.sessionId}&#96;,\n        label: session.sessionName,\n        timestamp: session.updateTime,\n        sessionId: session.sessionId,\n        category: 'ai' as const,\n        level: 2,\n        pinned: session.pinned || false,\n        favorited: isSessionFavorite(session.sessionId),\n      }),\n    )\n\n  if (aiSessions.length &gt; 0 || !searchKeyword.value) {\n    nodes.push({\n      id: 'category_ai',\n      label: '学伴默认',\n      category: 'ai' as const,\n      level: 1,\n      children: aiSessions,\n    })\n  }\n\n  // 2. 老师对话分类（包含所有写死的老师会话）\n  const allTeacherSessions = Object.values(teacherChatStore.loadAllSessions())\n\n  // 过滤老师会话（支持搜索）\n  const filteredTeacherSessions = searchKeyword.value\n    ? allTeacherSessions.filter((session) =&gt; {\n        const name = session.sessionName?.toLowerCase() || ''\n        const subject = session.subject?.toLowerCase() || ''\n        const searchLower = searchKeyword.value.toLowerCase().trim()\n        return name.includes(searchLower) || subject.includes(searchLower)\n      })\n    : allTeacherSessions\n\n  // 为每个过滤后的会话创建树节点\n  const teacherChildren: TreeNode[] = filteredTeacherSessions.map((session) =&gt; ({\n    id: &#96;teacher_${session.subject}_${session.sessionId}&#96;,\n    label: session.sessionName,\n    timestamp: session.createTime,\n    sessionId: session.sessionId,\n    category: session.subject as 'CHINESE' | 'MATH' | 'ENGLISH' | 'POLITICS' | 'HISTORY' | 'GEOGRAPHY' | 'PHYSICS' | 'CHEMISTRY' | 'BIOLOGY',\n    level: 2,\n  }))\n\n  // 如果有匹配的老师会话，显示\"老师对话\"分类\n  if (teacherChildren.length &gt; 0) {\n    nodes.push({\n      id: 'category_teacher',\n      label: '老师答疑',\n      category: 'teacher' as const,\n      level: 1,\n      children: teacherChildren,\n    })\n  }\n\n  return nodes\n})\n\n// VirtualList 组件会自动处理滚动，无需额外初始化\n\n// 判断节点是否被选中\n// 使用内部的 selectedSessionId，直接比较 sessionId\nconst isSelectedNode = (node: TreeNode): boolean =&gt; {\n  if (node.level === 1) return false // 分类节点不可选中\n\n  // 直接比较 sessionId，如果匹配则选中\n  return selectedSessionId.value === node.sessionId\n}\n\n// ==================== 工具函数 ====================\n\n// 根据ID查找节点\nconst findNodeById = (nodes: TreeNode[], targetId: string): TreeNode | null =&gt; {\n  for (const node of nodes) {\n    if (node.id === targetId) {\n      return node\n    }\n    if (node.children) {\n      const found = findNodeById(node.children, targetId)\n      if (found) return found\n    }\n  }\n  return null\n}\n\n\n// ==================== 方法 ====================\n\n// 检查会话是否有未读消息\nconst hasUnreadMessage = (node: TreeNode): boolean =&gt; {\n  if (!node.sessionId) return false\n\n  if (node.category === 'ai') {\n    // AI 会话未读 key 格式: ai_{sessionId}\n    return unreadStore.hasUnread(&#96;ai_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n  } else if (['CHINESE', 'MATH', 'ENGLISH', 'POLITICS', 'HISTORY', 'GEOGRAPHY', 'PHYSICS', 'CHEMISTRY', 'BIOLOGY'].includes(node.category)) {\n    // 教师会话未读 key 格式: teacher_{sessionId}\n    return unreadStore.hasUnread(&#96;teacher_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n  }\n\n  return false\n}\n\n// 处理会话点击（内部完成所有切换逻辑，只发送最终结果）\nconst handleSessionClick = async (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  console.log('[SessionTree] handleSessionClick 被调用，节点信息:', {\n    id: node.id,\n    category: node.category,\n    sessionId: node.sessionId,\n    label: node.label,\n    level: node.level\n  })\n  if (node.level !== 2 || !node.sessionId) {\n    console.log('[SessionTree] 节点不符合会话点击条件，跳过处理')\n    return\n  }\n\n  try {\n    if (node.category === 'ai') {\n      // AI 会话切换逻辑\n      unreadStore.clearUnread(&#96;ai_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n      await aiGeneralStore.switchSession(node.sessionId)\n      // 更新内部维护的选中会话ID和节点ID\n      // 使用 computed setter，会自动处理分类切换通知\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 设置AI会话ID:', node.sessionId)\n      selectedSessionId.value = node.sessionId\n      selectedNodeId.value = node.id\n\n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = treeNodes.value.length\n      if (oldLength !== newLength) {\n        console.log('[SessionTree] 树节点数量变化，触发handleTreeNodesChange')\n        previousTreeNodesLength = newLength\n        await handleTreeNodesChange(oldLength, newLength)\n      }\n\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 发出session-switched事件: ai,', node.sessionId)\n      emit('session-switched', 'ai', node.sessionId)\n    } else if (['CHINESE', 'MATH', 'ENGLISH', 'POLITICS', 'HISTORY', 'GEOGRAPHY', 'PHYSICS', 'CHEMISTRY', 'BIOLOGY'].includes(node.category)) {\n      // 教师会话切换逻辑\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 处理教师会话切换')\n      unreadStore.clearUnread(&#96;teacher_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n\n      // 查找会话数据（使用响应式的 allSessions ref，Pinia 会自动解包）\n      const allTeacherSessions = Object.values(teacherChatStore.loadAllSessions())\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 查找教师会话，当前会话数量:', allTeacherSessions.length)\n      const session = allTeacherSessions.find(s =&gt; s.sessionId === node.sessionId)\n      if (!session) {\n        console.error('[SessionTree] 未找到教师会话:', node.sessionId)\n        return\n      }\n\n      // 设置 localStorage 中的 currentTeacherSubject\n      const userId = getUserId()\n      const storeSubject = session.subject || 'MATH'\n      localStorage.setItem(&#96;${userId}_currentTeacherSubject&#96;, storeSubject)\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 设置教师科目到localStorage:', storeSubject)\n\n      // 设置会话并加载聊天历史\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 设置教师会话:', session.sessionId)\n      teacherChatStore.setSession(session)\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 开始加载教师聊天历史')\n      await teacherChatStore.loadChatHistory(session.sessionId)\n\n        // 初始化WebSocket连接（新增）\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 初始化教师WebSocket连接')\n      await teacherChatStore.initMessageReceiver().catch(error =&gt; {\n        console.error('[SessionTree] 初始化教师WebSocket失败:', error)\n      })\n\n      // 更新内部维护的选中会话ID和节点ID\n      // 使用 computed setter，会自动处理分类切换通知\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 设置选中会话ID:', node.sessionId)\n      selectedSessionId.value = node.sessionId\n      selectedNodeId.value = node.id\n      \n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = treeNodes.value.length\n      if (oldLength !== newLength) {\n        previousTreeNodesLength = newLength\n        await handleTreeNodesChange(oldLength, newLength)\n      }\n      \n      emit('session-switched', 'teacher', node.sessionId)\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('切换会话失败:', error)\n  }\n}\n\n\n// 处理置顶\nconst handlePin = async (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || node.category !== 'ai' || !node.sessionId) return\n\n  try {\n    // 直接调用 store 方法完成置顶操作\n    await aiGeneralStore.togglePin(node.sessionId)\n    \n    // 显示成功消息\n    showMessage('操作成功', 'positive')\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('置顶操作失败:', error)\n    showMessage('操作失败，请重试', 'negative')\n  }\n}\n\n// 关闭更多菜单并执行操作\nconst closeMenuAndExecute = (sessionId: string | undefined, action: () =&gt; void) =&gt; {\n  if (!sessionId) return\n  showMoreMenu.value[sessionId] = false\n  action()\n}\n\n// 处理收藏\nconst handleFavorite = (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || node.category !== 'ai' || !node.sessionId) return\n  \n  // 查找对应的会话数据\n  const session = aiGeneralStore.sessions.find(s =&gt; s.sessionId === node.sessionId)\n  if (!session) {\n    showMessage('未找到会话数据', 'negative')\n    return\n  }\n  \n  // 切换收藏状态\n  const success = toggleSessionFavorite(session)\n  if (success) {\n    // 触发收藏状态重新计算\n    favoriteUpdateTrigger.value++\n    \n    showMessage(isSessionFavorite(session.sessionId) ? '已收藏' : '已取消收藏', 'positive')\n  } else {\n    showMessage('操作失败，请重试', 'negative')\n  }\n}\n\n// 处理删除 - 显示确认对话框\nconst handleDelete = (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || !node.sessionId) return\n\n  // 显示删除确认对话框\n  pendingDeleteNode.value = node\n  deleteDialogRef.value?.openDialog()\n}\n\n// 确认删除\nconst confirmDelete = async () =&gt; {\n  const node = pendingDeleteNode.value\n  if (!node) return\n  deleting.value = true\n  try {\n  if (node.category === 'ai') {\n      // 检查是否是当前会话\n      const wasCurrentSession = aiGeneralStore.currentSession?.sessionId === node.sessionId\n      \n      // 直接调用 store 删除\n      await aiGeneralStore.deleteSession(node.sessionId)\n\n      // 如果该会话在收藏中，同步移除收藏\n      try {\n        removeSessionFavorite(node.sessionId)\n      } catch (e) {\n        console.warn('[SessionTree] 同步移除会话收藏失败（忽略）', e)\n      }\n      \n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = treeNodes.value.length\n      if (oldLength !== newLength) {\n        previousTreeNodesLength = newLength\n        await handleTreeNodesChange(oldLength, newLength)\n      }\n      \n      // 发送删除结果事件\n      emit('ai-session-deleted', node.sessionId, true, wasCurrentSession)\n\n      // 显示成功消息\n      showMessage('会话已删除', 'positive')\n  } else if (['CHINESE', 'MATH', 'ENGLISH', 'POLITICS', 'HISTORY', 'GEOGRAPHY', 'PHYSICS', 'CHEMISTRY', 'BIOLOGY'].includes(node.category)) {\n      // 老师会话不支持删除\n      showMessage('老师会话不支持删除', 'warning')\n      return;\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('删除会话失败:', error)\n    \n    // 发送删除失败事件\n    if (node.category === 'ai') {\n      emit('ai-session-deleted', node.sessionId, false, false)\n    } else if (node.category === 'BIOLOGY' || node.category === 'MATH') {\n      emit('teacher-session-deleted', node.sessionId, false, false)\n    }\n    \n    // 显示失败消息\n    showMessage('删除失败，请重试', 'negative')\n  } finally {\n    // 清理状态\n    deleting.value = false\n    deleteDialogRef.value?.closeDialog()\n    pendingDeleteNode.value = null\n  }\n}\n\n// 取消删除\nconst cancelDelete = () =&gt; {\n  deleteDialogRef.value?.closeDialog()\n  pendingDeleteNode.value = null\n}\n\n// 格式化时间（相对时间）\nconst formatTime = (timestamp: number): string =&gt; {\n  if (!timestamp) return ''\n\n  const now = Date.now()\n  const diff = now - timestamp\n\n  // 小于1分钟：刚刚\n  if (diff &lt; 60 * 1000) {\n    return '刚刚'\n  }\n\n  // 小于1小时：X分钟前\n  if (diff &lt; 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / (60 * 1000))\n    return &#96;${minutes}分钟前&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 小于24小时：X小时前\n  if (diff &lt; 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const hours = Math.floor(diff / (60 * 60 * 1000))\n    return &#96;${hours}小时前&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 小于48小时：昨天\n  if (diff &lt; 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const date = new Date(timestamp)\n    return &#96;昨天 ${String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 小于7天：X天前\n  if (diff &lt; 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const days = Math.floor(diff / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000))\n    return &#96;${days}天前&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 其他：显示月/日 时:分\n  const date = new Date(timestamp)\n  const month = date.getMonth() + 1\n  const day = date.getDate()\n  const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')\n  const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')\n\n  // 如果年份不是今年，显示年份\n  const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear()\n  if (date.getFullYear() !== currentYear) {\n    return &#96;${date.getFullYear()}/${month}/${day} ${hours}:${minutes}&#96;\n  }\n\n  return &#96;${month}/${day} ${hours}:${minutes}&#96;\n}\n\n// 获取当前选中节点对应的分类\n// 返回：'ai' | 教师科目 | null\n// 如果选中的是一级分类节点，返回该分类\n// 如果选中的是二级会话节点，返回该会话的分类\nconst getSelectedCategory = (): 'ai' | 'CHINESE' | 'MATH' | 'ENGLISH' | 'POLITICS' | 'HISTORY' | 'GEOGRAPHY' | 'PHYSICS' | 'CHEMISTRY' | 'BIOLOGY' | null =&gt; {\n  if (!selectedNodeId.value) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  // 查找选中的节点\n  const selectedNode = findNodeById(treeNodes.value, selectedNodeId.value)\n  if (!selectedNode) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  // 如果是一级分类节点\n  if (selectedNode.level === 1) {\n    // 如果是\"老师对话\"分类，返回null（需要进一步判断）\n    if (selectedNode.category === 'teacher') {\n      return null\n    }\n    return selectedNode.category as 'ai' | 'CHINESE' | 'MATH' | 'ENGLISH' | 'POLITICS' | 'HISTORY' | 'GEOGRAPHY' | 'PHYSICS' | 'CHEMISTRY' | 'BIOLOGY'\n  }\n\n  // 如果是二级会话节点，返回会话的分类\n  if (selectedNode.level === 2) {\n    return selectedNode.category as 'ai' | 'CHINESE' | 'MATH' | 'ENGLISH' | 'POLITICS' | 'HISTORY' | 'GEOGRAPHY' | 'PHYSICS' | 'CHEMISTRY' | 'BIOLOGY'\n  }\n\n  return null\n}\n\n// 切换到指定会话（供父组件调用）\nconst switchToSession = (type: 'ai' | 'teacher', sessionId: string) =&gt; {\n  if (type === 'teacher') {\n    // 触发教师会话切换逻辑（类似于 handleSessionClick 中的教师会话处理）\n    const allTeacherSessions = Object.values(teacherChatStore.loadAllSessions())\n    const session = allTeacherSessions.find(s =&gt; s.sessionId === sessionId)\n    if (session) {\n      // 设置会话\n      teacherChatStore.setSession(session)\n\n      // 更新选中状态\n      selectedSessionId.value = sessionId\n\n      // 设置 localStorage\n      const userId = getUserId()\n      const storeSubject = session.subject\n      localStorage.setItem(&#96;${userId}_currentTeacherSubject&#96;, storeSubject)\n\n      // 加载聊天历史\n      teacherChatStore.loadChatHistory(session.sessionId)\n\n      // 初始化WebSocket连接\n      teacherChatStore.initMessageReceiver().catch(error =&gt; {\n        console.error('[SessionTree] 初始化教师WebSocket失败:', error)\n      })\n\n      // 通知父组件切换分类\n      emit('category-should-change', 'teacher')\n    }\n  } else if (type === 'ai') {\n    // AI 会话切换逻辑\n    aiGeneralStore.switchSession(sessionId)\n    selectedSessionId.value = sessionId\n    emit('category-should-change', 'ai-general')\n  }\n}\n\n// 暴露方法供父组件调用\ndefineExpose({\n  getSelectedCategory,\n  switchToSession,\n})\n\n\n// 更新选中状态的辅助函数（仅用于同步外部状态，不处理未读标记）\n// 添加条件判断避免重复更新导致的死循环\nconst updateSelectedNode = (sessionId: string | undefined) =&gt; 选中的节点ID\nconst selectedNodeId = ref&lt;string | null&gt;(null)\n\n\n// 滚动容器引用\nconst scrollWrapper = ref&lt;HTMLElement | null&gt;(null)\n\n// 未读消息 store\nconst unreadStore = useUnreadMessageStore()\n\n// AI 和教师聊天 store\nconst aiGeneralStore = useAiGeneralChatStore()\nconst teacherChatStore = useTeacherChatStore()\n\n// 收藏状态更新触发器（用于触发 treeNodes 重新计算收藏状态）\n// 注意：收藏状态存储在 localStorage 中，不是响应式的，所以需要手动触发\nconst favoriteUpdateTrigger = ref(0)\n\n// 会话更多菜单显示状态（key 为 sessionId）\nconst showMoreMenu = ref&lt;Record&lt;string, boolean&gt;&gt;({})\n\n// 删除确认对话框\nconst deleteDialogRef = ref&lt;InstanceType&lt;typeof Dialog&gt;&gt;()\nconst pendingDeleteNode = ref&lt;TreeNode | null&gt;(null)\n\n// 删除处理中状态\nconst deleting = ref(false)\n\n// 删除确认内容\nconst deleteConfirmContent = computed(() =&gt; {\n  return &#96;确定要删除会话 \"${pendingDeleteNode.value?.label || ''}\" 吗？删除后无法恢复。&#96;\n})\n\n// ==================== 计算属性 ====================\n\n\n// 树节点类型定义\ninterface TreeNode {\n  id: string\n  label: string\n  category: 'ai' | 'teacher' | 'CHINESE' | 'MATH' | 'ENGLISH' | 'POLITICS' | 'HISTORY' | 'GEOGRAPHY' | 'PHYSICS' | 'CHEMISTRY' | 'BIOLOGY'\n  level: number\n  children?: TreeNode[]\n  sessionId?: string\n  timestamp?: number\n  subtitle?: string\n  pinned?: boolean\n  favorited?: boolean\n}\n\n// 构建树形节点\n// 使用 computed 从 store 的响应式数据中获取，自动同步更新\nconst treeNodes = computed&lt;TreeNode[]&gt;(() =&gt; {\n  // 依赖 favoriteUpdateTrigger 来触发收藏状态重新计算\n  void favoriteUpdateTrigger.value\n  \n  const nodes: TreeNode[] = []\n\n  // 1. AI聊天（学伴默认）分类\n  // aiGeneralStore.sessions 已经是响应式的 ref，computed 会自动追踪\n  const aiSessionsList = searchKeyword.value\n    ? aiGeneralStore.sessions.filter((session) =&gt; {\n        const name = session.sessionName?.toLowerCase() || ''\n        return name.includes(searchKeyword.value.toLowerCase().trim())\n      })\n    : aiGeneralStore.sessions\n  \n  const aiSessions = aiSessionsList\n    .sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n      // 置顶的排在前面\n      if (a.pinned &amp;&amp; !b.pinned) return -1\n      if (!a.pinned &amp;&amp; b.pinned) return 1\n      // 按更新时间倒序\n      return b.updateTime - a.updateTime\n    })\n    .map(\n      (session): TreeNode =&gt; ({\n        id: &#96;ai_${session.sessionId}&#96;,\n        label: session.sessionName,\n        timestamp: session.updateTime,\n        sessionId: session.sessionId,\n        category: 'ai' as const,\n        level: 2,\n        pinned: session.pinned || false,\n        favorited: isSessionFavorite(session.sessionId),\n      }),\n    )\n\n  if (aiSessions.length &gt; 0 || !searchKeyword.value) {\n    nodes.push({\n      id: 'category_ai',\n      label: '学伴默认',\n      category: 'ai' as const,\n      level: 1,\n      children: aiSessions,\n    })\n  }\n\n  // 2. 老师对话分类（包含所有写死的老师会话）\n  const allTeacherSessions = Object.values(teacherChatStore.loadAllSessions())\n\n  // 过滤老师会话（支持搜索）\n  const filteredTeacherSessions = searchKeyword.value\n    ? allTeacherSessions.filter((session) =&gt; {\n        const name = session.sessionName?.toLowerCase() || ''\n        const subject = session.subject?.toLowerCase() || ''\n        const searchLower = searchKeyword.value.toLowerCase().trim()\n        return name.includes(searchLower) || subject.includes(searchLower)\n      })\n    : allTeacherSessions\n\n  // 为每个过滤后的会话创建树节点\n  const teacherChildren: TreeNode[] = filteredTeacherSessions.map((session) =&gt; ({\n    id: &#96;teacher_${session.subject}_${session.sessionId}&#96;,\n    label: session.sessionName,\n    timestamp: session.createTime,\n    sessionId: session.sessionId,\n    category: session.subject as 'CHINESE' | 'MATH' | 'ENGLISH' | 'POLITICS' | 'HISTORY' | 'GEOGRAPHY' | 'PHYSICS' | 'CHEMISTRY' | 'BIOLOGY',\n    level: 2,\n  }))\n\n  // 如果有匹配的老师会话，显示\"老师对话\"分类\n  if (teacherChildren.length &gt; 0) {\n    nodes.push({\n      id: 'category_teacher',\n      label: '老师答疑',\n      category: 'teacher' as const,\n      level: 1,\n      children: teacherChildren,\n    })\n  }\n\n  return nodes\n})\n\n// VirtualList 组件会自动处理滚动，无需额外初始化\n\n// 判断节点是否被选中\n// 使用内部的 selectedSessionId，直接比较 sessionId\nconst isSelectedNode = (node: TreeNode): boolean =&gt; {\n  if (node.level === 1) return false // 分类节点不可选中\n\n  // 直接比较 sessionId，如果匹配则选中\n  return selectedSessionId.value === node.sessionId\n}\n\n// ==================== 工具函数 ====================\n\n// 根据ID查找节点\nconst findNodeById = (nodes: TreeNode[], targetId: string): TreeNode | null =&gt; {\n  for (const node of nodes) {\n    if (node.id === targetId) {\n      return node\n    }\n    if (node.children) {\n      const found = findNodeById(node.children, targetId)\n      if (found) return found\n    }\n  }\n  return null\n}\n\n\n// ==================== 方法 ====================\n\n// 检查会话是否有未读消息\nconst hasUnreadMessage = (node: TreeNode): boolean =&gt; {\n  if (!node.sessionId) return false\n\n  if (node.category === 'ai') {\n    // AI 会话未读 key 格式: ai_{sessionId}\n    return unreadStore.hasUnread(&#96;ai_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n  } else if (['CHINESE', 'MATH', 'ENGLISH', 'POLITICS', 'HISTORY', 'GEOGRAPHY', 'PHYSICS', 'CHEMISTRY', 'BIOLOGY'].includes(node.category)) {\n    // 教师会话未读 key 格式: teacher_{sessionId}\n    return unreadStore.hasUnread(&#96;teacher_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n  }\n\n  return false\n}\n\n// 处理会话点击（内部完成所有切换逻辑，只发送最终结果）\nconst handleSessionClick = async (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  console.log('[SessionTree] handleSessionClick 被调用，节点信息:', {\n    id: node.id,\n    category: node.category,\n    sessionId: node.sessionId,\n    label: node.label,\n    level: node.level\n  })\n  if (node.level !== 2 || !node.sessionId) {\n    console.log('[SessionTree] 节点不符合会话点击条件，跳过处理')\n    return\n  }\n\n  try {\n    if (node.category === 'ai') {\n      // AI 会话切换逻辑\n      unreadStore.clearUnread(&#96;ai_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n      await aiGeneralStore.switchSession(node.sessionId)\n      // 更新内部维护的选中会话ID和节点ID\n      // 使用 computed setter，会自动处理分类切换通知\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 设置AI会话ID:', node.sessionId)\n      selectedSessionId.value = node.sessionId\n      selectedNodeId.value = node.id\n\n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = treeNodes.value.length\n      if (oldLength !== newLength) {\n        console.log('[SessionTree] 树节点数量变化，触发handleTreeNodesChange')\n        previousTreeNodesLength = newLength\n        await handleTreeNodesChange(oldLength, newLength)\n      }\n\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 发出session-switched事件: ai,', node.sessionId)\n      emit('session-switched', 'ai', node.sessionId)\n    } else if (['CHINESE', 'MATH', 'ENGLISH', 'POLITICS', 'HISTORY', 'GEOGRAPHY', 'PHYSICS', 'CHEMISTRY', 'BIOLOGY'].includes(node.category)) {\n      // 教师会话切换逻辑\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 处理教师会话切换')\n      unreadStore.clearUnread(&#96;teacher_${node.sessionId}&#96;)\n\n      // 查找会话数据（使用响应式的 allSessions ref，Pinia 会自动解包）\n      const allTeacherSessions = Object.values(teacherChatStore.loadAllSessions())\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 查找教师会话，当前会话数量:', allTeacherSessions.length)\n      const session = allTeacherSessions.find(s =&gt; {\n        console.error('[SessionTree] 初始化教师WebSocket失败:', error)\n      })\n\n      // 更新内部维护的选中会话ID和节点ID\n      // 使用 computed setter，会自动处理分类切换通知\n      console.log('[SessionTree] 设置选中会话ID:', node.sessionId)\n      selectedSessionId.value = node.sessionId\n      selectedNodeId.value = node.id\n      \n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = treeNodes.value.length\n      if (oldLength !== newLength) {\n        previousTreeNodesLength = newLength\n        await handleTreeNodesChange(oldLength, newLength)\n      }\n      \n      emit('session-switched', 'teacher', node.sessionId)\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('切换会话失败:', error)\n  }\n}\n\n\n// 处理置顶\nconst handlePin = async (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || node.category !== 'ai' || !node.sessionId) return\n\n  try {\n    // 直接调用 store 方法完成置顶操作\n    await aiGeneralStore.togglePin(node.sessionId)\n    \n    // 显示成功消息\n    showMessage('操作成功', 'positive')\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('置顶操作失败:', error)\n    showMessage('操作失败，请重试', 'negative')\n  }\n}\n\n// 关闭更多菜单并执行操作\nconst closeMenuAndExecute = (sessionId: string | undefined, action: () =&gt; void) =&gt; {\n  if (!sessionId) return\n  showMoreMenu.value[sessionId] = false\n  action()\n}\n\n// 处理收藏\nconst handleFavorite = (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || node.category !== 'ai' || !node.sessionId) return\n  \n  // 查找对应的会话数据\n  const session = aiGeneralStore.sessions.find(s =&gt; '已收藏' : '已取消收藏', 'positive')\n  } else {\n    showMessage('操作失败，请重试', 'negative')\n  }\n}\n\n// 处理删除 - 显示确认对话框\nconst handleDelete = (node: TreeNode) =&gt; {\n  if (node.level !== 2 || !node.sessionId) return\n\n  // 显示删除确认对话框\n  pendingDeleteNode.value = node\n  deleteDialogRef.value?.openDialog()\n}\n\n// 确认删除\nconst confirmDelete = async () =&gt; {\n  const node = pendingDeleteNode.value\n  if (!node) return\n  deleting.value = true\n  try {\n  if (node.category === 'ai') {\n      // 检查是否是当前会话\n      const wasCurrentSession = aiGeneralStore.currentSession?.sessionId === node.sessionId\n      \n      // 直接调用 store 删除\n      await aiGeneralStore.deleteSession(node.sessionId)\n\n      // 如果该会话在收藏中，同步移除收藏\n      try {\n        removeSessionFavorite(node.sessionId)\n      } catch (e) {\n        console.warn('[SessionTree] 同步移除会话收藏失败（忽略）', e)\n      }\n      \n      // 数据更新后，手动处理 treeNodes 变化（替代 watch）\n      await nextTick()\n      const oldLength = previousTreeNodesLength\n      const newLength = treeNodes.value.length\n      if (oldLength !== newLength) {\n        previousTreeNodesLength = newLength\n        await handleTreeNodesChange(oldLength, newLength)\n      }\n      \n      // 发送删除结果事件\n      emit('ai-session-deleted', node.sessionId, true, wasCurrentSession)\n\n      // 显示成功消息\n      showMessage('会话已删除', 'positive')\n  } else if (['CHINESE', 'MATH', 'ENGLISH', 'POLITICS', 'HISTORY', 'GEOGRAPHY', 'PHYSICS', 'CHEMISTRY', 'BIOLOGY'].includes(node.category)) {\n      // 老师会话不支持删除\n      showMessage('老师会话不支持删除', 'warning')\n      return;\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('删除会话失败:', error)\n    \n    // 发送删除失败事件\n    if (node.category === 'ai') {\n      emit('ai-session-deleted', node.sessionId, false, false)\n    } else if (node.category === 'BIOLOGY' || node.category === 'MATH') {\n      emit('teacher-session-deleted', node.sessionId, false, false)\n    }\n    \n    // 显示失败消息\n    showMessage('删除失败，请重试', 'negative')\n  } finally {\n    // 清理状态\n    deleting.value = false\n    deleteDialogRef.value?.closeDialog()\n    pendingDeleteNode.value = null\n  }\n}\n\n// 取消删除\nconst cancelDelete = () =&gt; {\n  deleteDialogRef.value?.closeDialog()\n  pendingDeleteNode.value = null\n}\n\n// 格式化时间（相对时间）\nconst formatTime = (timestamp: number): string =&gt; {\n  if (!timestamp) return ''\n\n  const now = Date.now()\n  const diff = now - timestamp\n\n  // 小于1分钟：刚刚\n  if (diff &lt; 60 * 1000) {\n    return '刚刚'\n  }\n\n  // 小于1小时：X分钟前\n  if (diff &lt; 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / (60 * 1000))\n    return &#96;${minutes}分钟前&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 小于24小时：X小时前\n  if (diff &lt; 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const hours = Math.floor(diff / (60 * 60 * 1000))\n    return &#96;${hours}小时前&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 小于48小时：昨天\n  if (diff &lt; 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const date = new Date(timestamp)\n    return &#96;昨天 ${String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 小于7天：X天前\n  if (diff &lt; 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n    const days = Math.floor(diff / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000))\n    return &#96;${days}天前&#96;\n  }\n\n  // 其他：显示月/日 时:分\n  const date = new Date(timestamp)\n  const month = date.getMonth() + 1\n  const day = date.getDate()\n  const hours = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')\n  const minutes = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')\n\n  // 如果年份不是今年，显示年份\n  const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear()\n  if (date.getFullYear() !== currentYear) {\n    return &#96;${date.getFullYear()}/${month}/${day} ${hours}:${minutes}&#96;\n  }\n\n  return &#96;${month}/${day} ${hours}:${minutes}&#96;\n}\n\n// 获取当前选中节点对应的分类\n// 返回：'ai' | 教师科目 | null\n// 如果选中的是一级分类节点，返回该分类\n// 如果选中的是二级会话节点，返回该会话的分类\nconst getSelectedCategory = (): 'ai' | 'CHINESE' | 'MATH' | 'ENGLISH' | 'POLITICS' | 'HISTORY' | 'GEOGRAPHY' | 'PHYSICS' | 'CHEMISTRY' | 'BIOLOGY' | null =&gt; {\n  if (!selectedNodeId.value) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  // 查找选中的节点\n  const selectedNode = findNodeById(treeNodes.value, selectedNodeId.value)\n  if (!selectedNode) {\n    return null\n  }\n\n  // 如果是一级分类节点\n  if (selectedNode.level === 1) {\n    // 如果是\"老师对话\"分类，返回null（需要进一步判断）\n    if (selectedNode.category === 'teacher') {\n      return null\n    }\n    return selectedNode.category as 'ai' | 'CHINESE' | 'MATH' | 'ENGLISH' | 'POLITICS' | 'HISTORY' | 'GEOGRAPHY' | 'PHYSICS' | 'CHEMISTRY' | 'BIOLOGY'\n  }\n\n  // 如果是二级会话节点，返回会话的分类\n  if (selectedNode.level === 2) {\n    return selectedNode.category as 'ai' | 'CHINESE' | 'MATH' | 'ENGLISH' | 'POLITICS' | 'HISTORY' | 'GEOGRAPHY' | 'PHYSICS' | 'CHEMISTRY' | 'BIOLOGY'\n  }\n\n  return null\n}\n\n// 切换到指定会话（供父组件调用）\nconst switchToSession = (type: 'ai' | 'teacher', sessionId: string) =&gt; {\n  if (type === 'teacher') {\n    // 触发教师会话切换逻辑（类似于 handleSessionClick 中的教师会话处理）\n    const allTeacherSessions = Object.values(teacherChatStore.loadAllSessions())\n    const session = allTeacherSessions.find(s =&gt; s.sessionId === sessionId)\n    if (session) {\n      // 设置会话\n      teacherChatStore.setSession(session)\n\n      // 更新选中状态\n      selectedSessionId.value = sessionId\n\n      // 设置 localStorage\n      const userId = getUserId()\n      const storeSubject = session.subject\n      localStorage.setItem(&#96;${userId}_currentTeacherSubject&#96;, storeSubject)\n\n      // 加载聊天历史\n      teacherChatStore.loadChatHistory(session.sessionId)\n\n      // 初始化WebSocket连接\n      teacherChatStore.initMessageReceiver().catch(error =&gt; {\n        console.error('[SessionTree] 初始化教师WebSocket失败:', error)\n      })\n\n      // 通知父组件切换分类\n      emit('category-should-change', 'teacher')\n    }\n  } else if (type === 'ai') {\n    // AI 会话切换逻辑\n    aiGeneralStore.switchSession(sessionId)\n    selectedSessionId.value = sessionId\n    emit('category-should-change', 'ai-general')\n  }\n}\n\n// 暴露方法供父组件调用\ndefineExpose({\n  getSelectedCategory,\n  switchToSession,\n})\n\n\n// 更新选中状态的辅助函数（仅用于同步外部状态，不处理未读标记）\n// 添加条件判断避免重复更新导致的死循环\nconst updateSelectedNode = (sessionId: string | undefined) =&gt; {\n  // 如果 sessionId 相同，且对应的 nodeId 也相同，则跳过更新，避免死循环\n  if (sessionId === _selectedSessionId.value) {\n    if (sessionId) {\n      const node = findNodeBySessionId(treeNodes.value, sessionId)\n      if (node &amp;&amp; node.id === selectedNodeId.value) {\n        // 值没有变化，跳过更新\n        return\n      }\n    } else {\n      // 都是 undefined，跳过更新\n      return\n    }\n  }\n  \n  if (sessionId) {\n    const node = findNodeBySessionId(treeNodes.value, sessionId)\n    if (node) {\n      // 使用 computed setter，会自动处理分类切换通知\n      selectedSessionId.value = sessionId\n      selectedNodeId.value = node.id\n    } else {\n      // 如果找不到节点，可能是数据还未加载，先设置 selectedNodeId 为 null\n      selectedNodeId.value = null\n    }\n  } else {\n    // 使用 computed setter，会自动处理分类切换通知\n    selectedSessionId.value = undefined\n    selectedNodeId.value = null\n  }\n}\n\n// 处理 treeNodes 变化时的副作用（初始化 BetterScroll 和更新选中状态）\n// 替代 watch，在数据更新时手动调用\nconst handleTreeNodesChange = async (oldLength: number, newLength: number) =&gt; ref&lt;ExerciseItem[]&gt;([])\nconst selectedSubject = ref('math')\nconst selectedQuestionIndex = ref(-1)\nconst loading = ref(true)\n\n// 分屏组件模型值\nconst PAGE_SIZE = 50 // 每页显示50题\nconst 当前页码\n\n// 从 props 获取搜索和过滤状态\n// 兼容两种模式：\n// 1) 受控：父组件传入 searchQuery，并通过 update:searchQuery 更新\n// 2) 非受控：父组件不传 searchQuery，由组件内部维护\nconst internalSearchQuery = ref('')\nconst searchQuery = {\n  // 统一使用路由跳转到 PhotoSearchView（包括 Android 环境）\n  const subject = currentSubjectForPhotoSearch.value || 'math'\n  router.push({\n    path: '/photo-search',\n    query: { subject },\n  })\n}\n\n// 判断题目是否被选中（基于题目ID，支持筛选状态）\nconst isQuestionSelected = (questionId: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const idx = questionIndexMap.value.get(questionId)\n  return typeof idx === 'number' ? idx + 1 : 0\n}\n\n// 题目删除相关\nconst deletingIds = ref(new Set&lt;string&gt;()) //题目ID集合\nconst contentRefs = ref&lt;Map&lt;string, HTMLElement&gt;&gt;(new Map()) //题目卡片引用\nconst intersectionObservers = new Map&lt;string, IntersectionObserver&gt;() //题目卡片观察者\n\n// 题目渲染完成状态（用于更精确控制加载中的时长）\nconst questionRenderedMap = ref&lt;Map&lt;string, boolean&gt;&gt;(new Map()) //题目ID -&gt; 渲染完成状态映射\n\n// 更多菜单显示状态\nconst showMoreMenu = ref&lt;Record&lt;string, boolean&gt;&gt;({})\n\n// 图片预览相关状态\nconst showImagePreview = ref(false)\nconst previewImageUrl = ref&lt;string&gt;('')\n\n// 加载状态（用于驱动 RubberBandList 底部“正在加载...” 提示）\nconst renderingQuestions = ref(false)\n\n// 动态高度测量相关（方案A）\nconst questionHeights = ref&lt;Map&lt;string, number&gt;&gt;(new Map()) // 题目ID -&gt; {\n      if (!question.subject) return false\n\n      // 获取题目学科的各种可能格式\n      const questionSubject = question.subject.trim()\n      const questionSubjectUpper = questionSubject.toUpperCase()\n\n      // 检查是否匹配过滤学科的任何一种格式\n      return filterValues.some((value) =&gt; {\n  if (!el || questionCardRefs.value.has(questionId)) return\n\n  questionCardRefs.value.set(questionId, el)\n\n  // 使用 ResizeObserver 监听高度变化\n  const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver((entries) =&gt; {\n  moveQuestionToTop(questionId)\n})\n\n// 收藏功能已移除：相关状态与切换逻辑不再需要\n\n// 通用操作列表：构造更多菜单的 actions（根据策略能力决定显示哪些操作）\nconst buildMoreActions = (question: ExerciseItem, index: number) =&gt; {\n  const bmNo = question.bmNo\n  const currentStrategy = strategy.value\n\n  const wrap = (handler: () =&gt; '').toString().toUpperCase()\n  if (rawSubject.includes('BIOLOGY') || rawSubject.includes('生物')) {\n    return 'BIOLOGY'\n  }\n  return 'MATH'\n}\n\n\nconst openDeleteDialog = (question: ExerciseItem) deletingIds.value.add(question.bmNo)\n\n    // 清理高度缓存和观察器\n    cleanupQuestionHeight(question.bmNo)\n\n    try {\n      // 确定要删除的题目的科目\n      const questionSubject = question.subject || questions.value.push(question)\n\n      // 取消置顶后，选择原来位置（现在是最后）\n      const newIndex = questions.value.length - 1\n      selectedQuestionIndex.value = newIndex\n      await currentStrategy.selectQuestion(newIndex)\n\n      showMessage('已取消置顶', 'positive')\n    } else {\n      // 不在顶部，置顶操作\n      const question = questions.value.splice(currentIndex, 1)[0]\n      questions.value.unshift(question)\n\n      // 置顶后，直接将置顶的题目标记为选中（索引 0）\n      selectedQuestionIndex.value = 0\n      await currentStrategy.selectQuestion(0)\n\n      // 题目置顶后滚动到最顶部\n      await nextTick()\n      const container = document.querySelector('.question-cards-container')\n      if (container) {\n        container.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 通过策略同步到 store\n    await currentStrategy.setQuestions(questions.value, selectedSubject.value)\n\n  } catch {\n    showMessage('操作失败', 'error')\n  }\n}\n\n// 拍照搜题功能已移至父组件 ExerciseSolveView\n\n// 发送给AI\nconst sendToAi = async (question: ExerciseItem) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    \n    // 发出事件通知父组件切换到AI聊天界面\n    emit('startAiGuidance', question)\n    const aiExerciseStore = useAiExerciseChatStore()\n\n    // 根据题目 subject 计算要传给 AI 的学科\n    const aiSubject = getAiSubjectFromQuestion(question)\n\n    // 根据当前列表类型 / 策略判断使用哪个 store\n    const isHomeworkType = strategy.value?.getListTitle?.() === '我的作业' || props.type === 'homework'\n\n    if (isHomeworkType) {\n      // 作业场景：使用 homeworkStore\n      const homeworkStore = useHomeworkStore()\n\n      const storeIndex = homeworkStore.questions.findIndex(\n        (q: ExerciseItem) =&gt; q.bmNo === question.bmNo\n      )\n      if (storeIndex &lt; 0) {\n        showMessage('题目数据不同步，请重新加载', 'warning')\n        return\n      }\n\n      await homeworkStore.selectQuestion(storeIndex)\n\n      const current = homeworkStore.currentQuestion\n      if (!current) {\n        showMessage('请先选择一道题目', 'warning')\n        return\n      }\n\n      const questionBmNo = current.bmNo\n      await aiExerciseStore.clearChatHistory(questionBmNo)\n\n      const questionContent = current.question || current.title || '题目内容为空'\n      const initialMessage = &#96;我们开始吧，${questionContent}&#96;\n\n      await aiExerciseStore.sendMessage(\n        initialMessage,\n        current,\n        { id: '', userId: '' },\n        aiSubject,\n        'mate',\n        undefined,\n        true,\n      )\n    } else {\n      // 习题场景：沿用 questionStore 逻辑\n      const questionStore = useQuestionStore()\n\n      const storeIndex = questionStore.questions.findIndex(\n        (q: ExerciseItem) =&gt; q.bmNo === question.bmNo\n      )\n      if (storeIndex &lt; 0) {\n        showMessage('题目数据不同步，请重新加载', 'warning')\n        return\n      }\n\n      // 使用store中的索引来选择题目\n      await questionStore.selectQuestion(storeIndex)\n\n      // 第1步：检查是否选择了题目\n      if (!questionStore.currentQuestion) {\n        showMessage('请先选择一道题目', 'warning')\n        return\n      }\n\n      // 第2步：标记当前题目正在进行AI指导\n      questionStore.currentQuestion.isAiGuiding = true\n      questionStore.currentQuestion.beginGuideToSolve = true\n\n      // 第3步：清除聊天记录\n      const questionBmNo = questionStore.currentQuestion.bmNo\n      await aiExerciseStore.clearChatHistory(questionBmNo)\n      // 第4步：发送题目内容给AI进行分析（每次都是新的开始）\n      const questionContent =\n        questionStore.currentQuestion.question ||\n        questionStore.currentQuestion.title ||\n        '题目内容为空'\n      const initialMessage = &#96;我们开始吧，${questionContent}&#96;\n\n      await aiExerciseStore.sendMessage(\n        initialMessage,\n        questionStore.currentQuestion,\n        { id: '', userId: '' },\n        aiSubject,\n        'mate',\n        undefined,\n        true, // hidePrefix: true，存储到本地时去除\"我们开始吧\"前缀\n      )\n    }\n\n  } catch (error) {\n    // 发生错误时重置AI指导状态（仅对习题场景有效）\n    const questionStore = useQuestionStore()\n    if (questionStore.currentQuestion) {\n error.message : String(error)\n    console.error('[QuestionList] 启动AI指导失败:', {\n      error,\n      errorMessage,\n      questionId: question.bmNo,\n      questionTitle: errorMessage.includes('网络') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('Network') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('fetch')\n    ) {\n      userMessage = '启动AI指导失败：网络连接异常，请检查网络后重试'\n    } else if errorMessage.includes('auth') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('401') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('403')\n    ) {\n      userMessage = '启动AI指导失败：权限不足，请重新登录'\n    } else if (\n      errorMessage.includes('服务器') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('server') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('500')\n    ) {\n      userMessage = '启动AI指导失败：服务器异常，请稍后重试'\n    } else if (errorMessage) {\n      userMessage = &#96;启动AI指导失败：${errorMessage}&#96;\n    }\n\n    showMessage(userMessage, 'error')\n  }\n}\n\n// 打开微课（使用Web技术实现）\nconst openMiniClass = async (question: ExerciseItem) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 使用硬编码的微课URL\n    const classUrl = 'https://www.imates.com.cn:9099/demo/demo1.html'\n\n    if (!classUrl || classUrl.trim() === '') {\n      showMessage('该题目暂无微课', 'warning')\n      return\n    }\n\n    // 优先通过事件通知父组件（ExerciseSolveView）打开微课\n    emit('openMiniClass', question)\n  } catch {\n    showMessage('打开微课失败', 'error')\n  }\n}\n\n// 清理题目高度缓存和观察器\nconst cleanupQuestionHeight = (questionId: string) =&gt; {\n  // 清理高度缓存\n  questionHeights.value.delete(questionId)\n\n  // 清理观察器\n  const observer = resizeObservers.get(questionId)\n  if (observer) {\n    observer.disconnect()\n    resizeObservers.delete(questionId)\n  }\n\n  // 清理定时器\n  const timer = heightMeasurementTimers.get(questionId)\n  if (timer) {\n    clearTimeout(timer)\n    heightMeasurementTimers.delete(questionId)\n  }\n\n  // 清理引用\n  questionCardRefs.value.delete(questionId)\n}\n\n// 监听搜索变化，重置分页\nwatch(\n  searchQuery,\n  () =&gt; {\n    displayedCount.value = // 外部题目模式：不触发任何 store/API 加载，仅重置分页，让过滤逻辑基于 externalQuestions 生效\n    if (props.externalQuestions &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(props.externalQuestions)) {\n      displayedCount.value = [...currentStrategy.getQuestions()]\n    } else {\n      // 具体学科：加载指定学科的题目\n      const filterValue = String(newFilter).toUpperCase()\n      const targetSubject = filterValue.toLowerCase()\n\n      // currentQuestions.some((q) =&gt; {\n          const qSubject = (q.subject || '').toLowerCase()\n          return (\n            qSubject === targetSubject ||\n            qSubject.includes(targetSubject) ||\n            targetSubject.includes(qSubject)\n          )\n        })\n\n      // 如果当前没有目标科目的题目，需要重新加载\n      if (!hasTargetSubjectQuestions) {\n        selectedSubject.value = targetSubject\n        await currentStrategy.fetchQuestions({ subject: targetSubject, useLocalFirst: true })\n        questions.value = [...currentStrategy.getQuestions()]\n      }\n    }\n  },\n  { immediate: false }\n)\n\n// 组件卸载时清理资源\nonUnmounted(() =&gt; {\n  // 清理所有 Intersection Observer\n  intersectionObservers.forEach((observer) =&gt; {\n    observer.disconnect()\n  })\n  intersectionObservers.clear()\n\n  // 清理所有 ResizeObserver\n  resizeObservers.forEach((observer) =&gt; {\n    observer.disconnect()\n  })\n  resizeObservers.clear()\n\n  // 清理所有定时器\n  heightMeasurementTimers.forEach((timer) =&gt; {\n    clearTimeout(timer)\n  })\n  heightMeasurementTimers.clear()\n\n  // 清理窗口大小变化监听（如果有）\n  if (windowResizeCleanup) {\n }\n}\n\n// 分页切换处理\nconst handlePageChange = (page: number) =&gt; {\n  currentPage.value = page\n\n  // 切页后回到列表顶部\n  nextTick(() =&gt; {\n    const container = currentStrategy.selectQuestion(storeIndex)\n    }\n\n    // 等待DOM更新后滚动\n    await nextTick()\n    scrollToCurrentQuestion(targetIndex)\n  } catch {\n    // 滚动选择失败\n  }\n}\n\n// 题目置顶/取消置顶处理\nconst moveQuestionToTop = async (questionId: string) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const currentIndex = questions.value.findIndex((q) =&gt; q.bmNo === questionId)\n    if (currentIndex &lt; 0) return // 找不到题目\n\n    const currentStrategy = strategy.value\n\n    if (currentIndex === 0) {\n      // 已经在顶部，取消置顶 - 移到最后\n      const question = questions.value.splice(currentIndex, 1)[0]\n      questions.value.push(question)\n\n      // 取消置顶后，选择原来位置（现在是最后）\n      const newIndex = questions.value.length - 1\n      selectedQuestionIndex.value = newIndex\n      await currentStrategy.selectQuestion(newIndex)\n\n      showMessage('已取消置顶', 'positive')\n    } else {\n      // 不在顶部，置顶操作\n      const question = questions.value.splice(currentIndex, 1)[0]\n      questions.value.unshift(question)\n\n      // 置顶后，直接将置顶的题目标记为选中（索引 0）\n      selectedQuestionIndex.value = 0\n      await currentStrategy.selectQuestion(0)\n\n      // 题目置顶后滚动到最顶部\n      await 通过策略同步到 store\n    await currentStrategy.setQuestions(questions.value, selectedSubject.value)\n\n  } catch {\n    showMessage('操作失败', 'error')\n  }\n}\n\n// 拍照搜题功能已移至父组件 ExerciseSolveView\n\n//     return\n      }\n\n      await homeworkStore.selectQuestion(storeIndex)\n\n      const current = homeworkStore.currentQuestion\n      if (!current) {\n        showMessage('请先选择一道题目', 'warning')\n        return\n      }\n\n      const questionBmNo = current.bmNo\n      await aiExerciseStore.clearChatHistory(questionBmNo)\n\n      const questionContent = current.question || current.title ||      }\n\n      // 使用store中的索引来选择题目\n      await questionStore.selectQuestion(storeIndex)\n\n      // 第1步：检查是否选择了题目\n      if (!questionStore.currentQuestion) {\n        showMessage('请先选择一道题目',  userMessage = &#96;启动AI指导失败：${errorMessage}&#96;\n    }\n\n    showMessage(userMessage, 'error')\n  }\n}\n\n// 打开微课（使用Web技术实现）\nconst openMiniClass = async (question: ExerciseItem) =&gt; {\n  try {\n displayedCount: displayedCount.value,\n      total: displayList.value.length,\n    })\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n      renderingQuestions.value = false\n    }, 2000)\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('[QuestionList] ❌ 加载更多题目失败:', error)\n  }\n}\n\nconst loadQuestions = async () =&gt; {\n  // 如果父组件通过 externalQuestions 传入题目列表，则不再自行加载，只同步本地列表\n  if (props.externalQuestions &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(props.externalQuestions)) {\n    questions.value = [...props.externalQuestions]\n    if (questions.value.length &gt; 0) {\n      displayedCount.value = INITIAL_DISPLAY_COUNT\n      currentPage.value = 1\n    }\n    loading.value = false\n    return\n  }\n  \n  const currentStrategy = strategy.value\n  console.log('[QuestionList] 开始加载题目', {\n    type: props.type || 'exercise',\n    selectedSubjectFilter: selectedSubjectFilter.value,\n  })\n  loading.value = true\n\n  try {\n    // 第1步：如果策略的 store 中已有题目，直接使用\n    if (currentStrategy.hasQuestions()) {\n      console.log('[QuestionList] 使用 store 缓存题目', {\n        count: currentStrategy.getQuestions().length,\n      })\n      questions.value = [...currentStrategy.getQuestions()]\n    } else {\n      // 第2步：如果 store 中没有题目，需要确定科目并加载\n      if (selectedSubjectFilter.value === null) {\n        // 全部学科：加载所有学科的题目\n        console.log('[QuestionList] 从服务器加载全部学科题目')\n        await currentStrategy.fetchAllSubjectsQuestions(true)\n      } else {\n        // 具体学科：加载指定学科的题目\n        // selectedSubjectFilter 现在是大写枚举格式，需要转换为小写\n        const subjectToLoad = currentStrategy.fetchQuestions({ subject: subjectToLoad, useLocalFirst: true })\n      }\n\n      // 从策略获取题目列表\n      questions.value = [...currentStrategy.getQuestions()]\n    }\n\n    if (questions.value.length &gt; 0) {\n      displayedCount.value = INITIAL_DISPLAY_COUNT\n      currentPage.value = 1\n      console.log('[QuestionList] 加载题目完成', {\n        total: questions.value.length,\n        initialDisplay: displayedCount.value,\n      })\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    showMessage('加载题目失败: ' + ((error as Error)?.message || '未知错误'), 'error')\n  } finally {\n    console.log('[QuestionList] 结束加载题目')\n    loading.value = false\n  }\n}\n\n// 刷新题目列表数据（不重新加载，保持当前状态）\nconst refreshQuestions = () =&gt; {\n  // 从策略的 store 同步最新的题目列表\n  const currentStrategy = strategy.value\n  questions.value = [...currentStrategy.getQuestions()]\n\n  // 保持当前选中的题目索引\n  const currentIndex = currentStrategy.getCurrentQuestionIndex()\n  if (currentIndex &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; currentIndex &lt; questions.value.length) {\n    selectedQuestionIndex.value = currentIndex\n  }\n}\n\n// 下拉刷新处理（由 RubberBandList 触发）\n// 要求：强制重新请求接口，而不是只同步本地 store\nconst handlePullDownRefresh = async () =&gt; {\n  // 外部题目模式：仅同步 externalQuestions，不请求服务器\n  if (props.externalQuestions &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(props.externalQuestions)) {\n    try {\n      console.log('[QuestionList] 下拉刷新（外部题目模式）')\n      if (props.externalQuestions) {\n        questions.value = [...props.externalQuestions]\n      }\n    } finally {\n      const container = scrollContainer.value as any\n      if (container &amp;&amp; typeof container.finishRefresh === 'function') {\n        container.finishRefresh()\n      }\n    }\n    return\n  }\n  \n  const currentStrategy = strategy.value\n  try {\n    console.log('[QuestionList] 下拉刷新开始', {\n      type: props.type || 'exercise',\n      selectedSubject: selectedSubject.value,\n      filter: selectedSubjectFilter.value,\n    })\n\n    // 根据当前筛选条件决定刷新范围\n    if (selectedSubjectFilter.value === null) {\n      // 全部学科：强制从服务器拉取所有学科题目\n      await currentStrategy.fetchAllSubjectsQuestions(false)\n    } else {\n      // 单一学科：强制从服务器拉取\n      const subjectToRefresh = selectedSubject.value || 'math'\n      await currentStrategy.fetchQuestions({ subject: subjectToRefresh, useLocalFirst: false })\n    }\n\n    // 接口成功后，同步本地 questions 列表和当前选中索引\n    refreshQuestions()\n    console.log('[QuestionList] 下拉刷新完成', {\n      total: questions.value.length,\n    })\n  } catch (error) {\n    showMessage('刷新失败，请稍后重试', 'error')\n  } finally {\n    const container = scrollContainer.value as any\n    if (container &amp;&amp; typeof container.finishRefresh === 'function') {\n      container.finishRefresh()\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 搜索和过滤逻辑已通过计算属性实现，通过 watch 监听 props 变化来重置渲染状态\n\n// 题目选择方法\nconst selectQuestion = async (question: ExerciseItem, index: number) =&gt; {\n  if (index &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; index &lt; questions.value.length) {\n    selectedQuestionIndex.value = index\n\n    // 通过策略选择题目\n    const currentStrategy = strategy.value\n    const storeQuestions = currentStrategy.getQuestions()\n    const storeIndex = storeQuestions.findIndex(\n      (q: ExerciseItem) =&gt; q.bmNo === question.bmNo\n    )\n\n    if (storeIndex &gt;= 0) {\n      await currentStrategy.selectQuestion(storeIndex)\n    }\n\n    // 发出题目选择事件\n    emit('questionSelected', question, index)\n  }\n}\n\n// 定位到当前题目\nconst scrollToCurrentQuestion = (targetIndex?: number) =&gt; {\n  const indexToScroll = targetIndex !== undefined ? targetIndex : selectedQuestionIndex.value\n\n  if (indexToScroll &lt; 0 || !scrollContainer.value) {\n    return\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const list = displayList.value\n    if (indexToScroll &gt;= list.length) {\n      return\n    }\n\n    // 获取实际的滚动容器 DOM 元素\n    // scrollContainer 可能是 RubberBandList 组件实例或原生 HTMLElement\n    let actualContainer: HTMLElement | null = null\n    const container = scrollContainer.value as any\n    if (container.scrollContainerRef) {\n      // RubberBandList 组件，获取其内部的滚动容器\n      actualContainer = container.scrollContainerRef\n    } else if (container instanceof HTMLElement) {\n      // 原生 HTMLElement\n      actualContainer = container\n    }\n\n    if (!actualContainer) {\n      return\n    }\n\n    // 找到目标元素\n    const targetElement = actualContainer.querySelector(&#96;[data-index=\"${indexToScroll}\"]&#96;)\n    if (targetElement) {\n      const containerHeight = actualContainer.clientHeight\n      const elementTop = (targetElement as HTMLElement).offsetTop\n      const elementHeight = (targetElement as HTMLElement).offsetHeight\n\n      // 计算滚动位置，使目标元素居中\n      const targetScrollTop = Math.max(0, elementTop - (containerHeight - elementHeight) / 2)\n\n      // 滚动到目标位置\n      actualContainer.scrollTo({\n        top: targetScrollTop,\n        behavior: 'smooth',\n      })\n    }\n  } catch {\n    // 滚动失败\n  }\n}\n\n// 分页切换处理\nconst handlePageChange = (page: number) =&gt; {\n  currentPage.value = page\n\n  // 切页后回到列表顶部\n  nextTick(() =&gt; {\n    const container = document.querySelector('.question-cards-container') as HTMLElement | null\n    if (container) {\n      // 直接跳到顶部，不使用平滑滚动\n      container.scrollTop = 0\n    }\n  })\n}\n\n// 滚动到指定题目并设置为选中状态\nconst currentStrategy.selectQuestion(storeIndex)\n    }\n\n    // 等待DOM更新后滚动\n    await nextTick()\n    scrollToCurrentQuestion(targetIndex)\n  } catch {\n    // 滚动选择失败\n  }\n}\n\n// 题目置顶/取消置顶处理\nconst moveQuestionToTop = async (questionId: string) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const currentIndex = questions.value.findIndex((q) =&gt; q.bmNo === questionId)\n    if (currentIndex &lt; 0) return // 找不到题目\n\n    const currentStrategy = strategy.value\n\n    if (currentIndex === 0) {\n      // 已经在顶部，取消置顶 - 移到最后\n      const question = questions.value.splice(currentIndex, 1)[0]\n      questions.value.push(question)\n\n      // 取消置顶后，选择原来位置（现在是最后）\n      const newIndex = questions.value.length - 1\n      selectedQuestionIndex.value = newIndex\n      await currentStrategy.selectQuestion(newIndex)\n\n      showMessage('已取消置顶', 'positive')\n    } else {\n      // 不在顶部，置顶操作\n      const question = questions.value.splice(currentIndex, 1)[0]\n      questions.value.unshift(question)\n\n      // 置顶后，直接将置顶的题目标记为选中（索引 0）\n      selectedQuestionIndex.value = 0\n      await currentStrategy.selectQuestion(0)\n\n      // 题目置顶后滚动到最顶部\n      await nextTick()\n      const container = document.querySelector('.question-cards-container')\n      if (container) {\n        container.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 通过策略同步到 store\n    await currentStrategy.setQuestions(questions.value, selectedSubject.value)\n\n  } catch {\n    showMessage('操作失败', 'error')\n  }\n}\n\n// 拍照搜题功能已移至父组件 ExerciseSolveView\n\n// 发送给AI\nconst sendToAi = async (question: ExerciseItem) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    \n    // 发出事件通知父组件切换到AI聊天界面\n    emit('startAiGuidance', question)\n    const aiExerciseStore =     return\n      }\n\n      await homeworkStore.selectQuestion(storeIndex)\n\n      const current = homeworkStore.currentQuestion\n      if (!current) {\n        showMessage('请先选择一道题目', 'warning')\n        return\n      }\n\n      const questionBmNo = current.bmNo\n      await aiExerciseStore.clearChatHistory(questionBmNo)\n\n      const questionContent = current.question || current.title ||      }\n\n      // 使用store中的索引来选择题目\n      await questionStore.selectQuestion(storeIndex)\n\n      // 第1步：检查是否选择了题目\n      if (!questionStore.currentQuestion) {\n        showMessage('请先选择一道题目', =\n        questionStore.currentQuestion.question ||\n        questionStore.currentQuestion.title ||\n        '题目内容为空'\n      const initialMessage = &#96;我们开始吧，${questionContent}&#96;\n\n      await // hidePrefix: true，存储到本地时去除\"我们开始吧\"前缀\n      )\n    }\n\n  } catch (error) {\n    // 发生错误时重置AI指导状态（仅对习题场景有效）\n    const questionStore = useQuestionStore()\n    if (questionStore.currentQuestion) {\n      questionStore.currentQuestion.isAiGuiding = false\n      questionStore.currentQuestion.beginGuideToSolve = false\n    }\n\n    // 记录详细错误信息\n    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)\n    console.error('[QuestionList] 启动AI指导失败:', {\n      error,\n      errorMessage,\n      questionId: question.bmNo,\n      questionTitle: errorMessage.includes('网络') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('Network') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('fetch')\n    ) {\n      userMessage = '启动AI指导失败：网络连接异常，请检查网络后重试'\n    } else if errorMessage.includes('auth') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('401') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('403')\n    ) {\n      userMessage = '启动AI指导失败：权限不足，请重新登录'\n    } else if (\n      errorMessage.includes('服务器') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('server') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('500')\n    ) {\n      userMessage = '启动AI指导失败：服务器异常，请稍后重试'\n    } else if (errorMessage) {\n      userMessage = &#96;启动AI指导失败：${errorMessage}&#96;\n    }\n\n    showMessage(userMessage, 'error')\n  }\n}\n\n// 打开微课（使用Web技术实现）\nconst openMiniClass = async (question: ExerciseItem) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 使用硬编码的微课URL\n    const classUrl = 'https://www.imates.com.cn:9099/demo/demo1.html'\n\n    if (!classUrl || classUrl.trim() === '') {\n      showMessage('该题目暂无微课', 'warning')\n      return\n    }\n\n    // 优先通过事件通知父组件（ExerciseSolveView）打开微课\n    emit('openMiniClass', question)\n  } catch {\n    showMessage('打开微课失败', 'error')\n  }\n}\n\n// 清理题目高度缓存和观察器\nconst cleanupQuestionHeight = (questionId: string) =&gt; {\n  // 清理高度缓存\n  questionHeights.value.delete(questionId)\n\n  // 清理观察器\n  const observer = resizeObservers.get(questionId)\n  if (observer) {\n    observer.disconnect()\n    resizeObservers.delete(questionId)\n  }\n\n  // 清理定时器\n  const timer = heightMeasurementTimers.get(questionId)\n  if (timer) {\n    clearTimeout(timer)\n    heightMeasurementTimers.delete(questionId)\n  }\n\n  // 清理引用\n  questionCardRefs.value.delete(questionId)\n}\n\n// 监听搜索变化，重置分页\nwatch(\n  searchQuery,\n  () =&gt; {\n    displayedCount.value = // 外部题目模式：不触发任何 store/API 加载，仅重置分页，让过滤逻辑基于 externalQuestions 生效\n    if (props.externalQuestions &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(props.externalQuestions)) {\n      displayedCount.value = [...currentStrategy.getQuestions()]\n    } else {\n      // 具体学科：加载指定学科的题目\n      const filterValue = String(newFilter).toUpperCase()\n      const targetSubject = filterValue.toLowerCase()\n\n      // currentQuestions.some((q) =&gt; {\n          const qSubject = (q.subject || '').toLowerCase()\n          return (\n            qSubject === targetSubject ||\n            qSubject.includes(targetSubject) ||\n            targetSubject.includes(qSubject)\n          )\n        })\n\n      // 如果当前没有目标科目的题目，需要重新加载\n      if (!hasTargetSubjectQuestions) {\n        selectedSubject.value = targetSubject\n        await currentStrategy.fetchQuestions({ subject: targetSubject, useLocalFirst: true })\n        questions.value = [...currentStrategy.getQuestions()]\n      }\n    }\n  },\n  { immediate: false }\n)\n\n// 组件卸载时清理资源\nonUnmounted(() =&gt; {\n  // 清理所有 Intersection Observer\n  intersectionObservers.forEach((observer) =&gt; {\n    observer.disconnect()\n  })\n  intersectionObservers.clear()\n\n  // 清理所有 ResizeObserver\n  resizeObservers.forEach((observer) =&gt; {\n    observer.disconnect()\n  })\n  resizeObservers.clear()\n\n  // 清理所有定时器\n  heightMeasurementTimers.forEach((timer) =&gt; {\n    clearTimeout(timer)\n  })\n  heightMeasurementTimers.clear()\n\n  // 清理窗口大小变化监听（如果有）\n  if (windowResizeCleanup) {\n    window.removeEventListener('resize', windowResizeCleanup)\n    windowResizeCleanup = null\n  }\n\n  // 清理 MathJax\n  MathJaxUtils.cleanup()\n})\n\n// 窗口大小变化处理（可选，用于响应式布局）\nlet windowResizeCleanup: (() =&gt; void) | null = null\n\n// 生命周期\n// 监听 questions 变化，更新收藏状态\nwatch(\n  () =&gt; questions.value,\n  () =&gt; {\n    initFavoriteStatus()\n  },\n  { deep: true }\n)\n\nonMounted(() =&gt; {\n  loadQuestions()\n  initFavoriteStatus()\n\n  // 设置窗口大小变化监听\n  let resizeTimeout: ReturnType&lt;typeof setTimeout&gt;\n  const handleResize = () =&gt; {\n    clearTimeout(resizeTimeout)\n    resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n      // 重新测量所有已渲染的题目\n      questionCardRefs.value.forEach((el, questionId) =&gt; {\n        const index = displayList.value.findIndex((q) =&gt; q.bmNo === height)\n            indexToHeight.value.set(index, height)\n          }\n        }\n      })\n    }, 300)\n  }\n\n  window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize)\n  windowResizeCleanup = selectedQuestionIndex,\n  getSelectedQuestion: () =&gt; {\n    if (selectedQuestionIndex.value &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; selectedQuestionIndex.value &lt; questions.value.length) {\n      return questions.value[selectedQuestionIndex.value]\n    }\n    return null\n  },\n})\n&lt;/script&gt;\n\n&lt;style lang=\"scss\" scoped&gt;\n// ===== 变量定义 - Gemini 风格 =====\n$primary-color: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);\n\n// ===== 混合器定义 =====\n@mixin flex-center {\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  justify-content: center;\n}\n\n@mixin button-base {\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 16px;\n  transition: $transition-smooth;\n  cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n@mixin card-shadow($level: subtle) {\n  @if $level == subtle {\n    box-shadow: $shadow-subtle;\n  } @else if $level ref&lt;ExerciseItem[]&gt;([])\nconst selectedSubject = ref('math')\nconst selectedQuestionIndex = ref(-1)\nconst loading = ref(true)\n\n// 分屏组件模型值\nconst PAGE_SIZE = 50 // 每页显示50题\nconst 当前页码\n\n// 从 props 获取搜索和过滤状态\n// 兼容两种模式：\n// 1) 受控：父组件传入 searchQuery，并通过 update:searchQuery 更新\n// 2) 非受控：父组件不传 searchQuery，由组件内部维护\nconst internalSearchQuery = ref('')\nconst searchQuery = {\n  // 统一使用路由跳转到 PhotoSearchView（包括 Android 环境）\n  const subject = currentSubjectForPhotoSearch.value || 'math'\n  router.push({\n    path: '/photo-search',\n    query: { subject },\n  })\n}\n\n// 判断题目是否被选中（基于题目ID，支持筛选状态）\nconst isQuestionSelected = (questionId: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  if (!currentQuestion.value) {\n    return false\n  }\n  return currentQuestion.value.bmNo === questionId\n}\n\n// 题目全局序号映射：根据原始 questions 列表的位置计算（从 1 开始）\nconst questionIndexMap = computed(() =&gt; {\n  const map = new Map&lt;string, number&gt;()\n  questions.value.forEach((q, idx) =&gt; {\n    if (q.bmNo) {\n      map.set(q.bmNo, idx)\n    }\n  })\n  return map\n})\n\nconst getQuestionDisplayIndex = (questionId: string): number =&gt; {\n  const idx = questionIndexMap.value.get(questionId)\n  return typeof idx === 'number' ? idx + 1 : 0\n}\n\n// 题目删除相关\nconst deletingIds = ref(new Set&lt;string&gt;()) //题目ID集合\nconst contentRefs = ref&lt;Map&lt;string, HTMLElement&gt;&gt;(new Map()) //题目卡片引用\nconst intersectionObservers = new Map&lt;string, IntersectionObserver&gt;() //题目卡片观察者\n\n// 题目渲染完成状态（用于更精确控制加载中的时长）\nconst questionRenderedMap = ref&lt;Map&lt;string, boolean&gt;&gt;(new Map()) //题目ID -&gt; 渲染完成状态映射\n\n// 更多菜单显示状态\nconst showMoreMenu = ref&lt;Record&lt;string, boolean&gt;&gt;({})\n\n// 图片预览相关状态\nconst showImagePreview = ref(false)\nconst previewImageUrl = ref&lt;string&gt;('')\n\n// 加载状态（用于驱动 RubberBandList 底部“正在加载...” 提示）\nconst renderingQuestions = ref(false)\n\n// 动态高度测量相关（方案A）\nconst questionHeights = ref&lt;Map&lt;string, number&gt;&gt;(new Map()) // 题目ID -&gt; 高度映射\nconst indexToHeight = ref&lt;Map&lt;number, number&gt;&gt;(new Map()) // 索引 -&gt; 高度映射（便于快速查找）\nconst questionCardRefs = ref&lt;Map&lt;string, HTMLElement&gt;&gt;(new Map()) // 实际题目卡片引用\nconst resizeObservers = new Map&lt;string, ResizeObserver&gt;() // ResizeObserver映射\nconst heightMeasurementTimers = new Map&lt;string, ReturnType&lt;typeof setTimeout&gt;&gt;() // 延迟测量定时器\n\nconst deleteDialogRef = ref&lt;InstanceType&lt;typeof Dialog&gt; uiStore.miniClassQuestionTitle)\n\n\n// 计算属性\nconst filteredQuestions = computed(() =&gt; {\n  let result = questions.value\n\n  // 先应用学科过滤\n  if (selectedSubjectFilter.value) {\n    // selectedSubjectFilter 现在是大写枚举格式\n    const filterSubject = selectedSubjectFilter.value\n\n    // 获取过滤学科的所有可能值\n    const filterValues = SUBJECT_FILTER_MAP[filterSubject as keyof typeof SUBJECT_FILTER_MAP] || [filterSubject]\n\n    result = result.filter((question) =&gt; {\n      if (!question.subject) return false\n\n      // 获取题目学科的各种可能格式\n      const questionSubject = question.subject.trim()\n      const questionSubjectUpper = questionSubject.toUpperCase()\n\n      // 检查是否匹配过滤学科的任何一种格式\n      return filterValues.some((value) =&gt; {\n    if (el) {\n      contentRefs.value.set(questionId, el)\n\n\n      // 渲染MathJax\n      await MathJaxUtils.renderMath(el, false)\n\n      // 给图片添加点击事件监听器\n      await nextTick()\n      attachImageClickListeners(el)\n\n      // 标记该题目已完成渲染（包括公式和图片处理）\n      questionRenderedMap.value.set(questionId, true)\n    }\n  }\n\n// 给元素内的所有图片添加点击事件监听器\nconst attachImageClickListeners = (container: HTMLElement) =&gt; {\n  const images = container.querySelectorAll('img')\n  images.forEach((img) =&gt; {\n    // 避免重复添加监听器\n    if (img.dataset.hasClickListener === 'true') {\n      return\n    }\n\n    img.dataset.hasClickListener = 'true'\n    img.style.cursor = 'pointer'\n\n    img.addEventListener('click', (e) =&gt; {\n      e.stopPropagation()\n      const imageUrl = img.src\n      if (imageUrl) {\n        previewImageUrl.value = imageUrl\n        showImagePreview.value = true\n      }\n    })\n  })\n}\n\n// 设置实际题目卡片的引用并开始监听高度变化\nsetQuestionCardRefImpl = (el: HTMLElement | null, questionId: string, index: number) =&gt; {\n  if (!el || questionCardRefs.value.has(questionId)) return\n\n  questionCardRefs.value.set(questionId, el)\n\n  // 使用 ResizeObserver 监听高度变化\n  const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver((entries) =&gt; {\n    entries.forEach((entry) =&gt; {\n      // 使用 contentRect 或 target 的 getBoundingClientRect\n      const height = entry.target.getBoundingClientRect().height\n\n      // 等待内容稳定后再记录（避免频繁更新）\n      clearTimeout(heightMeasurementTimers.get(questionId))\n      const timer = setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        if (height &gt; 0) {\n          questionHeights.value.set(questionId, height)\n          indexToHeight.value.set(index, height)\n        }\n      }, 200) // 延迟200ms，等待MathJax渲染完成\n\n      heightMeasurementTimers.set(questionId, timer)\n    })\n  })\n\n  resizeObserver.observe(el)\n  resizeObservers.set(questionId, resizeObserver)\n\n  // 立即尝试测量一次（用于快速显示的题目）\n  nextTick(() =&gt; {\n    const height = el.getBoundingClientRect().height\n    if (height &gt; 0) {\n      // 延迟测量，等待可能的MathJax渲染\n      setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        const finalHeight = el.getBoundingClientRect().height\n        questionHeights.value.set(questionId, finalHeight)\n        indexToHeight.value.set(index, finalHeight)\n      }, 300) // 给MathJax更多时间\n    }\n  })\n}\n\n// 导出给模板使用（在模板中被使用，但 TypeScript 可能无法识别）\n// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars\nconst setQuestionCardRef = setQuestionCardRefImpl\n\n// 创建节流版本的方法\nconst throttledHandleCardClick = ThrottleUtils.fast(\n  async (question: ExerciseItem, index: number) =&gt; {\n    await selectQuestion(question, index)\n  }\n)\n\nconst throttledSendToAi = throttle((question: ExerciseItem) =&gt; {\n  sendToAi(question)\n}, 3000) // 3秒节流，防止频繁发送给AI\n\nconst throttledOpenMiniClass = ThrottleUtils.fast((question: ExerciseItem) =&gt; {\n  moveQuestionToTop(questionId)\n})\n\n// 收藏功能已移除：相关状态与切换逻辑不再需要\n\n// 通用操作列表：构造更多菜单的 actions（根据策略能力决定显示哪些操作）\nconst buildMoreActions = (question: ExerciseItem, index: number) =&gt; {\n  const bmNo = question.bmNo\n  const currentStrategy = strategy.value\n\n  const wrap = (handler: () =&gt; throttledOpenMiniClass(question)),\n    },\n    {\n      key: 'pin',\n      label: index === 0 ? '取消置顶' : '置顶',\n      icon: index === 0 ? quxiaozhidingIcon : zhidingIcon,\n      visible: currentStrategy.canMoveToTop(),\n      onClick: wrap(() =&gt; throttledMoveToTop(bmNo)),\n    },\n    \n    {\n      key: 'delete',\n      label: deletingIds.value.has(bmNo) ? 'icon-loading' : '',\n      visible: currentStrategy.canDelete(),\n      loading: deletingIds.value.has(bmNo),\n      onClick: wrap(() =&gt; openDeleteDialog(question)),\n    },\n  ]\n}\n\n// 根据题目的 subject 字段推断用于 AI 接口的学科（'MATH' 或 'BIOLOGY'）\nconst getAiSubjectFromQuestion = (question: ExerciseItem): 'MATH' | 'BIOLOGY' =&gt; {\n  const rawSubject = (question.subject || '').toString().toUpperCase()\n  if (rawSubject.includes('BIOLOGY') || rawSubject.includes('生物')) {\n    return 'BIOLOGY'\n  }\n  return 'MATH'\n}\n\n\nconst openDeleteDialog = (question: ExerciseItem) =&gt; {\n  deleteTargetQuestion.value = question\n  deleteWithChat.value = false\n  showDeleteDialog.value = true\n\n  nextTick(() =&gt; {\n    if (deleteDialogRef.value &amp;&amp; typeof deletingIds.value.add(question.bmNo)\n\n    // 清理高度缓存和观察器\n    cleanupQuestionHeight(question.bmNo)\n\n    try {\n      // 确定要删除的题目的科目\n      const questionSubject = question.subject || questionSubject.toLowerCase()\n      }\n      console.log(&#96;[QuestionList] ✅ 删除题目 ${question} 的科目是 ${subjectToDelete}&#96;)\n      // 使用API服务删除题目（使用 bmNo）\n      const success = await questions.value.findIndex(\n          (q) =&gt; q.id === question.id || q.bmNo === question.bmNo\n        )\n        if (localIndex !== -1) {\n          questions.value.splice(localIndex, 1)\n        }\n        // 根据是否删除对话记录给出不同提示\n        if (deleteWithChat.value) {\n          showMessage('题目及相关对话记录已删除', 'success')\n        } else {\n          showMessage('题目删除成功', 'positive')\n        }\n\n        // 根据当前筛选条件决定刷新方式\n        if (selectedSubjectFilter.value === null) {\n          // 全部学科：刷新所有学科的题目\n          await currentStrategy.fetchAllSubjectsQuestions(false)\n        } else {\n          // showMessage('删除题目时出错: ' + (error as Error).message, 'error')\n    deletingIds.value.delete(question.bmNo)\n  } finally {\n    showDeleteDialog.value = false\n    deleteTargetQuestion.value = null\n    deleteWithChat.value = false\n  }\n}\n\n// 切换更多菜单显示状态\nconst toggleMoreMenu = (questionId: string) =&gt; {\n  const currentValue = showMoreMenu.value[questionId] || false\n  showMoreMenu.value[questionId] = !currentValue\n}\n\n// 仅关闭指定题目的更多菜单\nconst closeMoreMenuById = (questionId: string) =&gt; {\n  showMoreMenu.value[questionId] = false\n}\n\n// 关闭更多菜单并执行操作\nconst currentPage.value = 1\n    }\n    loading.value = false\n    return\n  }\n  \n  const currentStrategy = strategy.value\n  console.log('[QuestionList] 开始加载题目', {\n    type: props.type || 'exercise',\n    selectedSubjectFilter: selectedSubjectFilter.value,\n  })\n  loading.value = true\n\n  try {\n    // 第1步：如果策略的 store 中已有题目，直接使用\n    if (currentStrategy.hasQuestions()) {\n {\n    console.log('[QuestionList] 结束加载题目')\n    loading.value = false\n  }\n}\n\n// 刷新题目列表数据（不重新加载，保持当前状态）\nconst refreshQuestions = () =&gt; {\n  // 从策略的 store 同步最新的题目列表\n  const currentStrategy = strategy.value\n  questions.value = [...currentStrategy.getQuestions()]\n\n  // 保持当前选中的题目索引\n  const currentIndex = currentStrategy.getCurrentQuestionIndex()\n  if (currentIndex &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; currentIndex &lt; questions.value.length) {\n    selectedQuestionIndex.value = currentIndex\n  }\n}\n\n// 下拉刷新处理（由 RubberBandList 触发）\n// 要求：强制重新请求接口，而不是只同步本地 store\nconst handlePullDownRefresh = console.log('[QuestionList] 下拉刷新开始', {\n      type: props.type || 'exercise',\n      selectedSubject: selectedSubject.value,\n      filter: selectedSubjectFilter.value,\n    })\n\n    // 根据当前筛选条件决定刷新范围\n    if (selectedSubjectFilter.value === null) {\n      // 全部学科：强制从服务器拉取所有学科题目\n      await currentStrategy.fetchAllSubjectsQuestions(false)\n    } else {\n      // 单一学科：强制从服务器拉取\n {\n    const container = scrollContainer.value as any\n    if (container &amp;&amp; typeof container.finishRefresh === 'function') {\n      container.finishRefresh()\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// 搜索和过滤逻辑已通过计算属性实现，通过 watch 监听 props 变化来重置渲染状态\n\n// 题目选择方法\nconst selectQuestion = async (question: ExerciseItem, index: number) =&gt; {\n  if (index &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; index &lt; }\n\n    // 发出题目选择事件\n    emit('questionSelected', question, index)\n  }\n}\n\n// 定位到当前题目\nconst scrollToCurrentQuestion = (targetIndex?: number) =&gt; {\n  const indexToScroll = targetIndex !== undefined ? targetIndex : selectedQuestionIndex.value\n\n  if (indexToScroll &lt; 0 || !scrollContainer.value) {\n    return\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const list = displayList.value\n    if (indexToScroll &gt;= list.length) {\n      return\n    }\n\n    // 获取实际的滚动容器 DOM 元素\n    // scrollContainer 可能是 RubberBandList 组件实例或原生 HTMLElement\n    let actualContainer: HTMLElement | null = null\n    const instanceof HTMLElement) {\n      // 原生 HTMLElement\n      actualContainer = container\n    }\n\n    if (!actualContainer) {\n      return\n    }\n\n    // 找到目标元素\n    const targetElement = }\n}\n\n// 分页切换处理\nconst handlePageChange = (page: number) =&gt; {\n  currentPage.value = page\n\n  // 切页后回到列表顶部\n  nextTick(() =&gt; {\n    const container = moveQuestionToTop = async (questionId: string) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const currentIndex = questions.value.findIndex((q) =&gt; q.bmNo === questionId)\n    if (currentIndex &lt; 0) return // 找不到题目\n\n    const currentStrategy = strategy.value\n\n    if (currentIndex === 0) {\n      // 已经在顶部，取消置顶 - 移到最后\n      const question = questions.value.splice(currentIndex, 1)[0]\n      questions.value.push(question)\n\n      // 取消置顶后，选择原来位置（现在是最后）\n      const newIndex = questions.value.length - 1\n      selectedQuestionIndex.value = newIndex\n      await     return\n      }\n\n      await homeworkStore.selectQuestion(storeIndex)\n\n      const current = homeworkStore.currentQuestion\n      if (!current) {\n        showMessage('请先选择一道题目', 'warning')\n        return\n      }\n\n      const questionBmNo = current.bmNo\n      await aiExerciseStore.clearChatHistory(questionBmNo)\n\n      const questionContent = current.question || current.title || errorMessage.includes('网络') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('Network') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('fetch')\n    ) {\n      userMessage = '启动AI指导失败：网络连接异常，请检查网络后重试'\n    } else if errorMessage.includes('auth') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('401') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('403')\n    ) {\n      userMessage = '启动AI指导失败：权限不足，请重新登录'\n    } else if (\n      errorMessage.includes('服务器') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('server') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('500')\n    ) {\n      userMessage = '启动AI指导失败：服务器异常，请稍后重试'\n    } else if (errorMessage) {\n      userMessage = &#96;启动AI指导失败：${errorMessage}&#96;\n    }\n\n    showMessage(userMessage, 'error')\n  }\n}\n\n// 打开微课（使用Web技术实现）\nconst openMiniClass = async (question: ExerciseItem) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    // 使用硬编码的微课URL\n    const classUrl = 'https://www.imates.com.cn:9099/demo/demo1.html'\n\n    if (!classUrl || classUrl.trim() === '') {\n      showMessage('该题目暂无微课', 'warning')\n      return\n    }\n\n    // 优先通过事件通知父组件（ExerciseSolveView）打开微课\n    emit('openMiniClass', question)\n  } catch {\n    showMessage('打开微课失败', 'error')\n  }\n}\n\n// 清理题目高度缓存和观察器\nconst cleanupQuestionHeight = heightMeasurementTimers.delete(questionId)\n  }\n\n  // 清理引用\n  questionCardRefs.value.delete(questionId)\n}\n\n// 监听搜索变化，重置分页\nwatch(\n  searchQuery,\n  () =&gt; {\n    displayedCount.value = currentQuestions.some((q) =&gt; {\n          const qSubject = (q.subject || '').toLowerCase()\n          return (\n            qSubject === targetSubject ||\n            qSubject.includes(targetSubject) ||\n            targetSubject.includes(qSubject)\n          )\n        })\n\n      // 如果当前没有目标科目的题目，需要重新加载\n      if (!hasTargetSubjectQuestions) {\n        selectedSubject.value = targetSubject\n        await currentStrategy.fetchQuestions({ subject: targetSubject, useLocalFirst: true })\n        questions.value = [...currentStrategy.getQuestions()]\n      }\n    }\n  },\n  { immediate: false }\n)\n\n// 组件卸载时清理资源\nonUnmounted(() =&gt; {\n  // 清理所有 Intersection Observer\n  intersectionObservers.forEach((observer) =&gt; {\n    observer.disconnect()\n  })\n  intersectionObservers.clear()\n\n  // 清理所有 ResizeObserver\n  resizeObservers.forEach((observer) =&gt; {\n    observer.disconnect()\n  })\n  resizeObservers.clear()\n\n  // 清理所有定时器\n  heightMeasurementTimers.forEach((timer) =&gt; {\n    clearTimeout(timer)\n  })\n  heightMeasurementTimers.clear()\n\n  // 清理窗口大小变化监听（如果有）\n  if (windowResizeCleanup) {\n    window.removeEventListener('resize', windowResizeCleanup)\n    windowResizeCleanup = null\n  }\n\n  // 清理 MathJax\n  MathJaxUtils.cleanup()\n})\n\n// 窗口大小变化处理（可选，用于响应式布局）\nlet windowResizeCleanup: (() =&gt; void) | null = null\n\n// 生命周期\n// 监听 questions 变化，更新收藏状态\nwatch(\n  () =&gt; questions.value,\n  () =&gt; {\n    initFavoriteStatus()\n  },\n  { deep: true }\n)\n\nonMounted(() =&gt; {\n  loadQuestions()\n  initFavoriteStatus()\n\n  // 设置窗口大小变化监听\n  let resizeTimeout: ReturnType&lt;typeof setTimeout&gt;\n  const handleResize = () =&gt; {\n    clearTimeout(resizeTimeout)\n    resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n      // 重新测量所有已渲染的题目\n      questionCardRefs.value.forEach((el, questionId) =&gt; {\n        const index = displayList.value.findIndex((q) =&gt; q.bmNo === /&gt;\n\n\n    &lt;!-- 图片预览对话框 --&gt;\n    &lt;ImageViewer v-model=\"showImagePreview\" :image-url=\"previewImageUrl\" alt=\"题目图片\" /&gt;\n\n    &lt;!-- 删除题目确认对话框（使用 Dialog 组件，插槽中维护删除聊天记录开关） --&gt;\n string\n  selectedSubjectFilter?: string | null\n  // 当父组件传入题目列表时，QuestionList 仅负责展示和操作，不再自行从 store/API 加载\n  externalQuestions?: ExerciseItem[]\n  // 是否显示拍照搜题按钮，默认 true\n  showPhotoSearch?: boolean\n ref&lt;ExerciseItem[]&gt;([])\nconst selectedSubject = ref('math')\nconst selectedQuestionIndex = ref(-1)\nconst loading = ref(true)\n\n// 分屏组件模型值\nconst PAGE_SIZE = 50 // 每页显示50题\nconst 当前页码\n\n// 从 props 获取搜索和过滤状态\n// 兼容两种模式：\n// 1) 受控：父组件传入 searchQuery，并通过 update:searchQuery 更新\n// 2) 非受控：父组件不传 searchQuery，由组件内部维护\nconst internalSearchQuery = ref('')\nconst searchQuery =
